description: Synthetic MinerU middle.json (layout.json), 4 pages (612x792, 612x792, 792x612 landscape, 612x792 empty), a short technical report on exciton transport. Built to cover the rare MinerU labels (caption, footnote, paragraph_title, vertical_text, formula_number, index, ref_text, algorithm, algorithm_caption, chart_footnote, code_footnote, equation, equation_interline, discarded, phonetic, header_image, footer_image) plus span types equation, inline_equation and hyperlink, and the geometry edge cases listed in geometry_cases. _backend=pipeline, _version_name=2.7.1; no preproc_blocks. Page 1: title, authors, index-less received line and margin vertical_text, overlapping body blocks, clamped-line block, interline equation + number, orphan-line block, footnote with hyperlink, discards header/header_image/page_number. Page 2: index (TOC), equation + number, image group with generic caption, indexed 'discarded' stamp, code group (algorithm_caption/algorithm/code_footnote), discards header/footer_image/page_number. Page 3: two columns + full-width chart group (chart_footnote), equation_interline + number, phonetic + Chinese text, ref_text x3, discards header/page_number. Page 4: empty (page_number only). raw_rejected.json is raw.json with block 0/para_blocks/2 pushed 1.5pt past the right page edge.

validator_rejects.case: 2. block + line + span exceed page width by 1.5pt
validator_rejects.stage: adapt_payload_to_document_v1 (build_validation_report -> validate_document_payload); same error from validate_document_payload alone
validator_rejects.tolerance: 1e-3 pt; the adapter passes block bboxes through unclamped, so a MinerU box 1-2pt past the page edge can only be fixed upstream (or by rescale)
validator_rejects.adjustment_in_raw_json: block bbox x1 613.5 -> 612, and the line and span x1 613.5 -> 612 (identical to raw_rejected.json otherwise)

tricky_points: Three display-formula aliases on three pages: interline_equation (p1), equation (p2, span type 'equation'), equation_interline (p3); the first two are MinerU pipeline/vlm naming, the third the content_list/newer naming. All project identically and none is reported as unknown.
image/chart/code groups: the container label (image, chart, code) is never emitted; children are, and the caption/footnote children are linked to the first image/table/code child.
chart_body, header_image, footer_image, image_body all collapse to content.kind=image with empty structure_role and empty text; formula and code blocks also have empty structure_role.
footnote (plain) is not translated but chart_footnote and code_footnote are; algorithm_caption -> structure_role code_caption, chart_caption -> figure_caption, generic caption -> caption.
index is catalogued as a container but aggregated into a single translated body record (table-of-contents dot leaders included).
vertical_text projects as ordinary body text; angle 270 is only metadata.
Index-less blocks sort after all indexed blocks even if they come earlier in para_blocks, and a discarded block with an index interleaves with para blocks.
Chinese lines are joined with a single ASCII space, so the Chinese paragraph text contains a space at the line break.
tags are not de-duplicated: footnote has ['footnote','footnote','skip_translation'], caption has ['caption','caption'].
Orphan-line splitting only checks that the line does not intersect the block bbox; the orphan record gets its own block_id, shifting every later id, and keeps the parent's raw_path and raw_index.

raw.json deliberately omits preproc_blocks and cross_page spans (covered by the two-column fixture); middle.json always has preproc_blocks in reality but the adapter ignores it unless cross_page spans exist.
Hyperlink spans carry a url and wrapper bbox in this fixture (key names invented to resemble MinerU); only the children's text/bbox survive normalization.
